en.askTitle: Swap in your own campus, dates and deposit limit and get the same housing comparison, with the deposit-safety checks before you pay
en.runTitle: Seoul housing for a Vietnamese master’s student at Yonsei: about KRW 800,000 a month, all-in, from March 2027

fields.label: Upfront deposit limit
fields.placeholder: e.g. no more than KRW 3,000,000 upfront

fields.label: Room, gender and access needs
fields.placeholder: e.g. single room, female-only floor, step-free access

fields.label: Adverts you already have
fields.placeholder: e.g. links to 3 listings you are considering

en.template: Compare housing near {campus} for {dates}, with {budget}, {deposit}, {programme}, {needs} and {adverts}. Separate all bills and deposits, flag document and refund risks, and list what to confirm before payment. Plan only; do not contact, apply, reserve or pay.

phases.title: Read the university’s official dorm notices and the government’s registration and housing rules
phases.note: Dorm fees and eligibility, foreigner registration, and the legal basis for deposit protection
phases.judgment: It would not let the exchange-student dorm pass as an option for a degree-seeking master’s student: the notice says “Exchange/visiting students only”. It also said that no spring 2027 dates or fees had been published, and labelled the 2026 dates as past examples, not 2027 deadlines.

phases.title: Check at least ten live listings and compare the full monthly cost of each
phases.note: Listings in Sinchon, Yeonhui, Hongdae and Mangwon, plus how to check a building’s ownership record
phases.judgment: It flagged conflicting official guidance rather than picking one silently: an address change is to be reported within 15 days, while some local government pages still say 14. It also stated that the 90-day window for registering as a foreigner is not 90 days of protected housing rights, and removed citations it could not match to the right source.

phases.title: Build the guide page and source list, then check the files
phases.judgment: The finished guide says plainly what is not known: spring 2027 dorm dates were not found published, and a live advert does not guarantee a room is free in March. Before delivery it re-checked the listing count, internal links and the budget arithmetic.

workers: Read Yonsei’s official housing notices for graduate dorm fees, who can apply and when applications open
Collected current public listings in Yeonhui and Mangwon, covering goshiwon, share houses and one-rooms, so rent, deposit and fees could be compared
Read official Korean government pages on foreigner registration, reporting an address change, and how to look up a building’s ownership record

zh.askTitle: 把校区、日期和押金上限换成你的，就能得到同样的住房对比，以及付款前的押金安全检查
zh.runTitle: 延世大学的越南籍硕士生在首尔找房：2027 年 3 月入学，每月全包约 80 万韩元

fields.label: 抵达和离开日期
fields.value: 2027 年 3 月 1 日起，住 12 个月

fields.label: 纯住房还是全部生活的预算
fields.value: 每月全包约 80 万韩元

fields.label: 前期押金上限
fields.placeholder: 例如：前期押金最多 300 万韩元

fields.label: 项目和国籍
fields.value: 国际硕士生，越南籍，24 岁

fields.label: 房型、性别和无障碍需求
fields.placeholder: 例如：单人间、女生楼层、无台阶通道

fields.label: 已有的房源广告
fields.placeholder: 例如：你在考虑的 3 条房源链接

zh.template: 请比较{campus}附近、{dates}期间的住房，预算为{budget}，前期押金最多{deposit}，我的项目及国籍是{programme}，房型、性别及无障碍需求为{needs}，已有广告为{adverts}。分清所有账单和押金，提醒文件及退款风险，列出付款前要确认什么。只做计划，不联系、不申请、不留房、不付款。

phases.title: 读学校官方宿舍通知，以及政府关于外国人登记和租房保护的规定
phases.note: 宿舍费用和申请资格、外国人登记、押金保护的法律依据
phases.judgment: 它没有把交换生宿舍当作可选项：公告写明“仅限交换生或访问生”，而提问的是读学位的硕士生。它还写明 2027 年春季学期的日期和费用没有公布，并把 2026 年的日期标成过往参考，不当作 2027 年的截止日。

phases.title: 核对至少十个在线房源，算出每个的完整月费用
phases.note: 新村、延禧、弘大、望远四个片区的房源，以及怎样查建筑物的产权记录
phases.judgment: 遇到官方说法不一致，它没有悄悄选一个，而是标了出来：搬家后的地址变更应在 15 天内申报，而个别地方政府页面仍写 14 天。它还写明，外国人登记的 90 天期限不等于 90 天受保护的租住权利，并删掉了对不上来源的引用。

phases.title: 做出指南页和来源清单，并检查文件
phases.judgment: 最终指南直接写出了不知道的部分：2027 年春季宿舍的日期没有找到公布，网上有房源也不保证三月还有空房。交付前它重新核对了房源数量、内部链接和预算算术。

workers: 读延世大学官方的住宿通知：研究生宿舍的费用、谁能申请、什么时候申请
收集延禧和望远一带当前公开的房源，包括考试院、合租屋和一居室，方便比较房租、押金和杂费
读韩国政府官网页面：外国人登记、搬家后的地址申报，以及怎样查一栋楼的产权记录
